plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Geographic Information Systems (GIS) A.S. Degree (Full Time, Fall Start)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 12, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7304/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: local AA/AS, Start Term: Fall. Total Units 60 = 15+15+15+15 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). Elective courses: any elective courses numbered 100-499, or having a 4-digit number starting with C. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. Scheduling: all in-person classes begin at 6:00 PM, except GEOG 330 (offered at 6:00 PM and 1:00 PM); GEOG 350, 360, and 385 are offered in the fall; GEOG 342, 362, and 375 are offered in the spring. A GEOG 498 internship (at least 1 unit) is required and also works toward satisfying GE Area L7B.
